cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,datetime
d=json.load(open('/tmp/open.json'))
now=datetime.datetime(2026,11,17,13,50)
rows=[]
for it in d['items']:
    rw=it.get('rewards') or {}
    paid=len(rw); top1=rw.get('1',0)
    dl=it.get('deadline','')[:19]
    try: dt=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(dl)
    except: dt=None
    hrs=(dt-now).total_seconds()/3600 if dt else None
    rows.append((hrs,it['slug'],it.get('potUsd'),it.get('entryFeeUsd') or 0,paid,top1,it.get('submissionCount'),(it.get('resolution') or {}).get('method')))
rows.sort(key=lambda r:(r[0] if r[0] is not None else 1e9))
print(f"{'sisa jam':>8} {'slug':28} {'pot':>7} {'fee':>5} {'plg':>4} {'#1':>6} {'entri':>7} metode")
for h,s,pot,fee,paid,t1,sc,meth in rows:
    print(f"{h if h is None else round(h,1):>8} {s:28} {pot:>7} {fee:>5} {paid:>4} {t1:>6} {sc:>7} {meth}")
